raw.query: SELECT predictor, resolution, wape FROM provenance.forecast_eval WHERE signal = 'images' AND resolution IN ('15s', '1min') AND predictor IN ('arima', 'prophet', 'constant', 'kalman', 'naive', 'ewma', 'holt_winters') ORDER BY resolution, wape;
raw.observed: At 15s, arima (0.6675) and prophet (0.7328) outperform the best classical baseline (naive at 0.7638). At 1min, arima (0.5213) outperforms the best classical baseline (ewma at 0.5217).
raw.claimed: Dynamo's four predictors (ARIMA, Kalman, Prophet, constant) at shipped defaults all at/below classical frontier, none reach foundation model level on image signal
raw.evidence: Lower WAPE means better forecasting; ARIMA (0.6675) and Prophet (0.7328) outperform the best classical baseline (naive at 0.7638) at 15s, meaning they sit above the classical frontier.
raw.fix: Correct the text to clarify that ARIMA and Prophet outperform the classical baseline frontier on the image signal at 15s resolution.
